ideas.title: Murmuration
ideas.critique: An island-wide dusk event with a spectacle in the sky shaped like the drift and the other occasional events, and the friends watching is the usual gathering. Thousands of boid agents filling the sky is a real change in scale and emergent behaviour, so it is a nice twist, but a traced film of many tiny emitters/instances is a technical risk.

ideas.title: What lives under us
ideas.critique: A hidden simulation shown through an instrument is new to the island, and Gloop acting on a readout is a new kind of loop. It still ends up as one more pier prop and a sonar panel, and the sonar sound cannot be checked here.

ideas.title: My reflection has a mind of its own
ideas.critique: It is the same recipe as the shadow that runs off: a detached copy of Lumi dodges, Lumi chases and shouts. The water-surface twist and lagging mirror are charming but the payoff is predictable.

ideas.title: Steer the island
ideas.critique: It is the next step of the drift, so the form is the same whole-island motion, now with a wheel. Turning the entire world as a playable vessel is a bold change, but it is predictable from the last post and much of it is the player-mode event pattern already used.

ideas.title: A walk through the dark with lanterns
ideas.critique: Lanterns and evening light were done in Lamps on and in the lantern evening posts, and a parade of friends is an existing pattern. It does serve the goal of showing path-traced light, but the idea itself is expected.

ideas.title: Acrobat
ideas.critique: A Lumi-led set piece with friends holding up score cards is the usual gag recipe with a physics skin. Honest failed flips from computed rotation add some body-and-physics novelty, though the goals name that example.

ideas.title: Sleep-talk
ideas.critique: Turning the agent's real diary into sleep mumbles ties the game to the actual rhythm in a fresh way, and nothing visual is needed. It is a sound layer with a small gag and cannot be shown in a still or film.

ideas.title: Under the island
same_form: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: A new realm under the sea changes what the island is and gives a view nobody has seen, and light shafts and caustics suit traced rendering. It is a place addition by form, but the scale of the change is large, and fish and weed are the main content.

ideas.title: Snore choir
ideas.critique: Emergent synchrony in sleep is a clever small rule, but it repeats the choir and music layer already done and is mostly audible, so it is not visible in a film. Sleeping creatures at night is already covered by Lights out.

ideas.title: Sand sculptures
ideas.critique: Friends gather and make an object that a tool generates, then it is judged or fails comically: the PIE and gallery recipe again, with erosion as the only twist. Friends admiring friends is a nice touch but an expected one.
